measurement_version: ads.feedback-measurements.v1; ads.feedback-dynamics.v1 for separately identified dynamic conditions
physical_scope: Exact saved raw values/UID/geometry; replay relocates bindings without resampling, mapping or trimming. Nominal resistor values only; profile-excluded effects remain excluded.

plan.decision: Bonferroni-adjusted paired t intervals for absolute-error differences across the four contrasts and two conditions. Lower bound >0 supports a nonzero benefit; lower bound above the stated minimum supports a useful benefit. Otherwise retain inconclusive minimum comparisons, including any reversal. No estimate is manufacturing yield.
plan.exposure: Known first-study and follow-on development/allocation evidence. Same follow-on seed, unused indices2000..2520, disjoint from allocation0..23/100..697 and feedback development24..43. Earlier first-study seed differs even when ordinal indices might match. Environmental settings are known; the saved physical targets are unexposed at the later barrier. Deleted old campaign data cannot be exhaustively compared.
plan.missing: Keep every assignment. Numeric unusability, unsupported domains and unresolved physical inputs are distinct from valid physical specification failures. More than 1 percent missing pairs prevents a full sampled-model comparison; report available conditional evidence. No redraw.

precision.allowance: The 1.25 pilot-SD multiplier is an explicit planning allowance, not a confidence bound on variance, guaranteed final width or a power calculation.
precision.engineering_reason: 20/25-mV active-to-feedback minimum benefits justify a substantial new resistor/input interface; 6-mV precision resolves those large changes. A 4-mV PMOS-area benefit is 16 percent of the fixed center-error allowance and must justify 1.94 um2 more area; target half width 1.5 mV. An 8-mV R75 advantage is a material 32 percent of the center allowance; target half width 3 mV.
precision.method: Smallest common integer n with t_(1-.05/(2*8),n-1) * 1.25 * development paired SD / sqrt(n) <= each stated target half width.

selected_large_signal.condition: Nominal VDD1, load100k||1p, 26.85C and external Vin.45V/Rsrc1k; no bias/candidate change.
selected_large_signal.purpose: A bounded held-out check of the observed nominal linearity tradeoff under several unexposed physical perturbations. Six shared coordinates produce 24 explicit waveform cases, with no dynamic population rate or all-cohort joint qualification. Selection is fixed before any target; base observations do not permit replacement or tuning.

plan.stopping: Exactly the declared saved cohort and conditions once. No sample extension, trim, rebias, recentering, candidate revision or relaxed limits after targets. Main acquisition stops after three consecutive numerical failures for bounded diagnosis; sparse waveform acquisition stops at its first unusable attempt. Retain all partial attempts and retry only necessary identical saved inputs in a new directory.
